project_type: Android TV companion app (POC) — Java, single :app module. SceneVibe TV Companion is a foreground overlay 'regie' that renders cloud-assigned commentary over Prime Video using passive MediaSession timing.
language: Java 17 (Android), plus Python 3 for boundary tests
build_system: Gradle (AGP 8.7.3 applied in build.gradle, apply false). NO Gradle wrapper in repo. CI installs gradle via gradle/actions/setup-gradle at version 8.9. Task mandates Gradle 8.9 / JDK 17.
test_framework: JUnit4 (junit:junit:4.13.2) with org.json:json:20240303 for pure-JVM deterministic tests via testImplementation; testOptions.unitTests.returnDefaultValues=true so Android stubs return defaults. Python unittest for boundary (tests/test_poc_contract.py).
verification_instructions: 1) python3 -m unittest discover -s tests (13+ tests). 2) Gradle 8.9/JDK17 with ANDROID_HOME set: :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:lintDebug :app:assembleDebug. 3) Compile LAN DEV path: SCENEVIBE_ENABLE_LAN_DEV=true :app:assembleDebug. 4) Compile Consumer Cloud path: SCENEVIBE_CLOUD_ORIGIN=https://interface-scenevibe-3wxg.vercel.app :app:assembleDebug. 5) If possible :app:assembleRelease (unsigned; do NOT touch signing). All must be green.

key_patterns: Injectable seams for deterministic JVM tests: CloudTrackRepository has `interface Storage { String get; boolean save(long,String); boolean saveAck(long); void clear(); }` with a Context ctor (SharedPreferences.commit, durable-on-true) and a Storage ctor for tests. CloudControlClient has injectable ScheduledExecutorService/CloudDeviceCredentials seams. MediaSyncedTrackScheduler.Listener { onRender(Event); onPlayback(playing, pauseFreezesDisplay); onEligibility(eligible) } is the temporal authority — the regie must subscribe to these events, NOT create its own clock. OverlayManifestParser.parse(JSONObject) throws Invalid (fail-closed). CloudProtocol.validAssignment already cross-checks product=='video' && sourceId==trackId && clockMode=='media' at the envelope level. SceneRenderer(Context, AssetResolver, Runnable permissionLost) with render(Scene)/dismiss(Scene)/dismissNow(). Diagnostics via DiagnosticsStore.INSTANCE + RuntimeDiagnostics enums (observational only, never gate logic, never log content/secrets).
